name: generate_image
description: Generate an image from a text prompt using a configured image model provider, save it locally, and return a preview artifact. Supports OpenAI Image API compatible providers, Google Gemini/Nano Banana, and Alibaba DashScope/Qwen-Image when the selected provider config contains the right API key/base URL.

prompt.description: Detailed visual prompt describing subject, composition, style, mood, lighting, text, aspect ratio, and constraints.

provider.description: Optional provider override: openai, openai_compatible, google, gemini, nano_banana, qwen, dashscope, aliyun, or alibaba.

api_style.description: Optional API adapter override: openai_images, gemini_generate_content, or dashscope_multimodal. Use openai_images for any provider that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /images/generations endpoint.

provider_config_id.description: Optional saved provider config id to use. Defaults to the default agent config.

model.description: Optional image model. Any model id supported by the selected API adapter is accepted. If omitted, an image-capable model from the saved config is reused; otherwise defaults by adapter: gpt-image-1.5, gemini-2.5-flash-image, or qwen-image-2.0-pro.

size.description: Optional output size. OpenAI style uses 1024x1024; Qwen accepts width*height and x is converted to *.

quality.description: Optional quality hint for OpenAI-compatible models, for example low, medium, high, or auto.

background.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible background setting: auto, transparent, or opaque.

output_format.description: Optional image format preference: png, jpeg, or webp.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt, currently used by Qwen/DashScope.

prompt_extend.description: Optional Qwen prompt rewriting flag. Defaults to true for Qwen.

watermark.description: Optional Qwen watermark flag. Defaults to false.

output_dir.description: Optional directory for the saved image. Defaults to generated-images under the first registered source or current directory.

output_path.description: Optional exact output file path. If provided, parent directories are created. Paths must stay inside a registered source root when sources exist.

filename.description: Optional output filename. Extension is inferred from output_format when missing.
